newsitem.title: USA: BISYS sees Q3 EPS in-line, before charge.
newsitem.headline: BISYS sees Q3 EPS in-line, before charge.

text.p: BISYS Group Inc said Wednesday it will take a third quarter charge of $0.03 a share for commission charges in connection with its alliance with Furman Selz, and absent this commission charge, BISYS' expected earnings for the fiscal third quarter will be in line with analysts' consensus.
BISYS said it finalized the previously announced alliance. The deal generated more assets than initially contemplated.
BISYS said mutual fund assets associated with former Furman Selz clients totaled approximately $35 billion as of March 31, 1997 compared with $18 billion last June.
BISYS total mutual fund assets serviced as of March 31, 1997 approximated $165 billion.

Under the terms of the alliance with Furman Selz, the increased assets and associated increased revenues to BISYS caused an additional commission charge of approximately $900,000, net of tax, or $0.03 per share.
